workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(exemption_reasons) -> [PROVED]
intent_berth: none, because a defect does not route through /intent (CLAUDE.md: a bug goes straight to TICKET); the ruling CairnCommons/decisions/2026-09-10-exemption-reasons-are-not-rulings.json is the origin record

watchme.trigger: on the beat, at the at-rest probe sweep over class-space
watchme.enough: 30 consecutive days with every declared site passing AND at least one site added or changed in the window - a set that never moves while code keeps being written is a museum, not a measurement, so stillness alone is not enough
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: declared site count, per-site justification kind, pass count, and any site whose path no longer resolves
watchme.consumer: build_inspector's diagnostic surface and the operator inbox, where a failing site is a red to fix rather than a note to read

owner: CC builds it; cairn/machines/build_inspector owns the sieve's address; cairn/machines/exemptions owns the declared set
